summary: Iteration 3 delta testing (Weather Alerts + UploadZone notes/mic). Added 4 new backend tests to /app/backend/tests/test_agriscan_api.py: test_weather_geocode, test_weather_forecast, test_weather_forecast_missing_params, test_diagnose_with_notes_persisted. All 4 delta tests pass. Regression across health, calculator, market/*, voice/transcribe, advisor/meta, advisor/districts, market listing CRUD (10/10 pass). Frontend on public URL: WeatherCard renders with 7-DAY OUTLOOK label, weather-current-temp (28°), 7 weather-day-item rows, and 7 weather-spray-badge chips (all 'Avoid' for Pune monsoon window). City search: clicking the search icon reveals weather-city-input; typing 'Nashik' with keyboard.type shows weather-city-result options; clicking one changes the header from 'Pune, Maharashtra' -> 'Nashik, Maharashtra' and re-fetches forecast (27°). UploadZone: after choosing an image, upload-notes-input textarea is visible with upload-voice-input-button mic sibling; typing into notes updates the field; analyze button remains enabled (not clicked to save LLM credits — backend note-passing already verified via test_diagnose_with_notes_persisted). Regression: EN<->हिं toggle correctly swaps 'AgriScan' <-> 'एग्रीस्कैन'.
critical_code_review_comments: weather.forecast() uses blocking requests.get inside an async endpoint (server.py:307). Under load this blocks the FastAPI event loop; consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool. Same pattern as flagged for mandi_live in iteration 2.

WeatherCard onSearch debounce (300ms) works well interactively but Playwright's .fill() bypasses the React onChange properly only intermittently; not a product bug — noted for future test authors (use page.keyboard.type).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (weather card, city search, notes+mic, lang toggle all verified)

test_credentials: None required; suite self-registers a fresh user per session
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_agriscan_api.py now has 22 tests including weather + notes-persistence. Weather endpoints hit live Open-Meteo (no key). If open-meteo times out from the pod, /api/weather/forecast returns 502 (currently working fine). Frontend WeatherCard defaults to Pune when no geolocation; city search debounces 300ms then calls /api/weather/geocode. UploadZone notes textarea + mic verified without triggering /api/diagnose to keep LLM cost low.
